claim_boundary: A positive result supports offline task-conditioned selection of one logged physical poke for held cross-intervention drop queries.

It does not establish online probe execution, same-state counterfactual outcomes, unique material identification, calibrated full-state uncertainty, deployment safety, or closed-loop manipulation success.
If exact drop-outcome freshness cannot be established, the evidence class is retrospective real-data mechanism evidence.

object_split.calibration_selection_rule: within each family remove target object_ids, sort by SHA256(salt,NUL,calibration,NUL,object_id); take first one

family_rules.rule: object_id contains Foam or equals Sponge or ToiletPaperRoll

object_split.target_selection_rule: within each family sort eligible object_ids by SHA256(salt,NUL,target,NUL,object_id); take first two

primary_analysis.dependence_attribution_endpoint: loss of task-conditioned advantage under object-matched probe-query dependence destruction
primary_analysis.task_dependence_endpoint: fraction of target objects receiving different selected probes for the two registered queries

components: final template-diagonal-normalized symmetric Chamfer distance to initial mesh

risk_and_cost.risk_thresholds: frozen on source and calibration objects

action_descriptor.boundary: isolated semantic slicer; byte-level carrier co-location is acknowledged
descriptor: tool location relative to the initial mesh

source_gate.failed_gate_behavior: stop before target probe selection or target drop access
required: both registered queries have positive task-conditioned calibration value
task-conditioned mean calibration loss is lower than no-probe
task-conditioned mean calibration loss is no worse than source-fixed-safe
task-conditioned mean calibration loss is no worse than generic-latent-information
dependence destruction removes at least half of the task-conditioned advantage over no-probe
at least two distinct probes are selected across calibration objects for at least one registered query
all unsafe probes are rejected and all zero-value cases return exact no-probe fallback

stages: exact historical exposure scan for every target drop take
target action-descriptor slicing and probe selection
joint sealing of all target drop-query predictions
single target drop-outcome opening and scoring

take_roles.target_candidate_probe_rule: sort complete target-object poking take_ids by SHA256(salt,NUL,probe,NUL,object_id,NUL,take_id); take first four
take_roles.target_drop_rule: all complete dropping takes of each primary target object are held challenges
